newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling weakens versus dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling weakens versus dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling marginally weakened against the dollar but was posted firmer on the pound on Friday, central Bank of Tanzania dealers said.
The shilling traded at a mean rate of 602.91 against the dollar versus 601.92 on Thursday. Against the pound, the shilling was posted at 979.0083 compared to 979.8084 on Thursday.
Dealers said there was a lot of demand for dollars.
"Everyone is chasing for dollars and no one is selling," said one central bank treasury official.
